author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

This PR collects a miscellaneous sets of developments to have more thorough testing of the HLT nano flavour produced in the package `HLTrigger/NGTScouting`. 
Main developments:
- add more thorough coverage of the quantities in the `hltNanoDQM`
- restore the unit test `testProduceNanoHLT` with fresh input data from `CMSSW_20_0_0_pre1`
- add two new families of relval workflows with offsets `.7592` and  `.7721` which test the case of HLT nano production out of `FEVTDEBUGHLT `input (from previous step) for both the HLT timing menu and the NGT scouting menu.
   - the workflows are added both in the ph2_hlt and nano matrices.

#### PR validation:

- `runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt -i all --ibeos` runs fine.
- `scram b runtests_testProduceNanoHLT` runs fine.
